dialogs.about: 외출 전 어떤 옷을 입을지 딸과 상의

lines.en: What should I wear today? Help me choose.
lines.ko: 오늘 뭘 입어야 할까요? 고르는 것 좀 도와줘요.

lines.en: Mom, the blue dress looks good on you.
I wore that dress last week.
How about the white shirt and black pants?
Good idea. Where is my gray jacket?
lines.ko: 좋은 생각이에요. 내 회색 재킷은 어디 있어요?

lines.en: It's on the chair in your bedroom.
A button came off this shirt yesterday.
I will fix it for you now.
Thank you. Will you bring my brown shoes?
Sure. And put on warm socks, too.
Hello. Can I help you today?
Yes, please. I like this blue shirt.
lines.ko: 네, 부탁해요. 이 파란 셔츠가 마음에 들어요.

lines.en: What size do you wear?
I wear a small. Do you have one?
Yes. Here is a small one with white buttons.
lines.ko: 네. 여기 흰 단추가 달린 스몰이 있어요.

lines.en: I bought a large shirt here last month.
This one will fit you better.
Can I try it on with this skirt?
lines.ko: 이 치마랑 같이 입어 봐도 돼요?

lines.en: Sure. The room is next to the jackets.
Thank you. I will pay with a card.
